declarations.formal_text: abbrev Ω : Type := AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ)

structure Model (N : ℕ) where
  K : IntermediateField ℚ Ω
  u : K
  v : K
  transcendental_u : Transcendental ℚ u
  equation : u ^ N + v ^ N = 1
  generate : ℚ⟮u, v⟯ = ⊤
  finite_u : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮u⟯ K
  degree_u : Module.finrank ℚ⟮u⟯ K = N

abbrev Place (K : Type*) [Field K] : Type _ :=
  {O : ValuationSubring K // O ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ O}
abbrev ResidueField (P : Place K) : Type _ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField P.1

noncomputable def residue (P : Place K) : P.1 →+* P.ResidueField :=
  IsLocalRing.residue P.1

def PlacesDiscrete (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1

def ResiduesFinite (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, FiniteDimensional ℚ P.ResidueField

noncomputable def ord (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (P : Place M.K) (f : M.K) : ℤ := by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1 := hDVR P
  exact -WithZero.log (((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation M.K) f)

def cusps (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K) : Set (Place M.K) :=
  {P | ord M hDVR P φ ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < ord M hDVR P (φ - 1)}

noncomputable def ramIdx (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (φ : M.K) (P : Place M.K) : ℤ := by
  classical
  exact if h : φ ∈ P.1 then
    ord M hDVR P (Polynomial.aeval φ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩)))
  else -ord M hDVR P φ
abbrev Divisor (M : Model N) : Type := Place M.K →₀ ℤ

noncomputable def cuspDivisor (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K)
    (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) : Divisor M :=
  ∑ P ∈ hfin.toFinset, Finsupp.single P 1

noncomputable def poleMultiplicity (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (f : M.K) (P : Place M.K) : ℤ :=
  max 0 (-ord M hDVR P f)

structure CanonicalDivisorData (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) where
  D : Divisor M
  coefficient : ∀ P : Place M.K,
    D P = if M.u ∈ P.1 then ramIdx M hDVR M.u P - 1
      else -ramIdx M hDVR M.u P - 1

noncomputable def valuation (P : Place K) : Valuation K ℤᵐ⁰ :=
  (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation K
noncomputable def ord (P : Place K) (f : K) : ℤ := -WithZero.log (P.valuation f)
theorem ord_zero : P.ord 0 = 0 := by simp [ord]

theorem ord_eq_placeOrd {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) [IsCurveField M.K]
    (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (P : Place M.K) (f : M.K) :
    ord M hDVR P f = P.ord f := rfl

theorem belyiCanonicalCuspCoefficientIdentity {N : ℕ}
    (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (hRF : ResiduesFinite M)
    (φ : M.K) (hφ : IsBelyi M hDVR φ)
    (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) :

      (if φ ∈ P.1 then ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1
        else -ramIdx M hDVR φ P - 1) + cuspDivisor M hDVR φ hfin P =
        poleMultiplicity M hDVR φ P + ord M hDVR P (φ * (φ - 1))

structure Model (N : ℕ) where
  K : IntermediateField ℚ Ω
  u : K
  v : K
  transcendental_u : Transcendental ℚ u
  equation : u ^ N + v ^ N = 1
  generate : ℚ⟮u, v⟯ = ⊤
  finite_u : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮u⟯ K
  degree_u : Module.finrank ℚ⟮u⟯ K = N

abbrev Place (K : Type*) [Field K] : Type _ :=
  {O : ValuationSubring K // O ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ O}
abbrev ResidueField (P : Place K) : Type _ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField P.1

noncomputable def residue (P : Place K) : P.1 →+* P.ResidueField :=
  IsLocalRing.residue P.1

def PlacesDiscrete (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1

def ResiduesFinite (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, FiniteDimensional ℚ P.ResidueField

noncomputable def ord (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (P : Place M.K) (f : M.K) : ℤ := by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1 := hDVR P
  exact -WithZero.log (((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation M.K) f)

def cusps (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K) : Set (Place M.K) :=
  {P | ord M hDVR P φ ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < ord M hDVR P (φ - 1)}

noncomputable def ramIdx (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (φ : M.K) (P : Place M.K) : ℤ := by
  classical
  exact if h : φ ∈ P.1 then
    ord M hDVR P (Polynomial.aeval φ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩)))
  else -ord M hDVR P φ
abbrev Divisor (M : Model N) : Type := Place M.K →₀ ℤ

noncomputable def cuspDivisor (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K)
    (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) : Divisor M :=
  ∑ P ∈ hfin.toFinset, Finsupp.single P 1

noncomputable def poleMultiplicity (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (f : M.K) (P : Place M.K) : ℤ :=
  max 0 (-ord M hDVR P f)

  D : Divisor M

    D P = if M.u ∈ P.1 then ramIdx M hDVR M.u P - 1

  (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation K

declarations.formal_text: abbrev Ω : Type := AlgebraicClosure (RatFunc ℚ)

structure Model (N : ℕ) where
  K : IntermediateField ℚ Ω
  u : K
  v : K
  transcendental_u : Transcendental ℚ u
  equation : u ^ N + v ^ N = 1
  generate : ℚ⟮u, v⟯ = ⊤
  finite_u : FiniteDimensional ℚ⟮u⟯ K
  degree_u : Module.finrank ℚ⟮u⟯ K = N

abbrev Place (K : Type*) [Field K] : Type _ :=
  {O : ValuationSubring K // O ≠ ⊤ ∧ ∀ q : ℚ, (q : K) ∈ O}
abbrev ResidueField (P : Place K) : Type _ := IsLocalRing.ResidueField P.1

noncomputable def residue (P : Place K) : P.1 →+* P.ResidueField :=
  IsLocalRing.residue P.1

def PlacesDiscrete (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1

def ResiduesFinite (M : Model N) : Prop :=
  ∀ P : Place M.K, FiniteDimensional ℚ P.ResidueField

noncomputable def ord (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (P : Place M.K) (f : M.K) : ℤ := by
  letI : IsDiscreteValuationRing P.1 := hDVR P
  exact -WithZero.log (((IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation M.K) f)

def cusps (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K) : Set (Place M.K) :=
  {P | ord M hDVR P φ ≠ 0 ∨ 0 < ord M hDVR P (φ - 1)}

noncomputable def ramIdx (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (φ : M.K) (P : Place M.K) : ℤ := by
  classical
  exact if h : φ ∈ P.1 then
    ord M hDVR P (Polynomial.aeval φ (minpoly ℚ (P.residue ⟨φ, h⟩)))
  else -ord M hDVR P φ
abbrev Divisor (M : Model N) : Type := Place M.K →₀ ℤ

noncomputable def cuspDivisor (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (φ : M.K)
    (hfin : (cusps M hDVR φ).Finite) : Divisor M :=
  ∑ P ∈ hfin.toFinset, Finsupp.single P 1

noncomputable def poleMultiplicity (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M)
    (f : M.K) (P : Place M.K) : ℤ :=
  max 0 (-ord M hDVR P f)

structure CanonicalDivisorData (M : Model N) (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) where
  D : Divisor M
  coefficient : ∀ P : Place M.K,
    D P = if M.u ∈ P.1 then ramIdx M hDVR M.u P - 1
      else -ramIdx M hDVR M.u P - 1

noncomputable def valuation (P : Place K) : Valuation K ℤᵐ⁰ :=
  (IsDiscreteValuationRing.maximalIdeal P.1).valuation K
noncomputable def ord (P : Place K) (f : K) : ℤ := -WithZero.log (P.valuation f)
theorem ord_zero : P.ord 0 = 0 := by simp [ord]

theorem ord_eq_placeOrd {N : ℕ} (M : Model N) [IsCurveField M.K]
    (hDVR : PlacesDiscrete M) (P : Place M.K) (f : M.K) :
    ord M hDVR P f = P.ord f := rfl

There is no separate lower-bound hypothesis on $N$; a model with these properties cannot have $N=0$. A place $P$ means any valuation subring $O_P\subsetneq F$ containing $\mathbb Q$, with residue field $\kappa(P)=O_P/\mathfrak m_P$ and residue map $ho_P$. The explicit hypotheses $h_{\mathrm{DVR}}$ and $h_{\mathrm{RF}}$ assert, respectively, that every such $O_P$ is a discrete valuation ring and that every $\kappa(P)$ is finite-dimensional over $\mathbb Q$. Write $
u_P(f)$ for the normalized integer order obtained as minus the discrete logarithm of the maximal-ideal valuation supplied by $O_P$, whose value group is the multiplicative copy of $\mathbb Z$ with an adjoined zero; its totalized value is $
u_P(0)=0$. For any $f\in F$, put $e_f(P)=
u_P(m_{ho_P(f)}(f))$ when $f\in O_P$, where $m_{ho_P(f)}\in\mathbb Q[X]$ is the minimal polynomial over $\mathbb Q$ of the residue of $f$; when $f
otin O_P$, put $e_f(P)=-
u_P(f)$. Define $a_f(P)=e_f(P)-1$ in the first branch and $a_f(P)=-e_f(P)-1$ in the second branch; all these subtractions are in $\mathbb Z$. For the explicit function $\varphi\in F$, set $C_\varphi=\{P:
u_P(\varphi)
e0\ \lor\ 0<
u_P(\varphi-1)\}$ and $b_\varphi(P)=\max\{0,-
u_P(\varphi)\}$. The explicit Belyi hypothesis $h_\varphi$ means that $\varphi$ is transcendental over $\mathbb Q$ and, for every place $P$, $1<e_\varphi(P)$ implies $P\in C_\varphi$. Thus $\varphi
e0,1$. The explicit finiteness proof $h_{\mathrm{fin}}$ states that this very set $C_\varphi$ is finite; it supplies the reduced divisor $C=\sum_{Q\in C_\varphi}[Q]$, where $[Q]$ has coefficient $1$ at $Q$ and $0$ elsewhere. In particular $C(P)=1$ on $C_\varphi$ and $C(P)=0$ outside it, using the supplied finite-support proof. The explicit canonical-divisor datum $\mathcal K$ supplies an integer-valued finitely supported divisor $D$ on all these places together with the equality $D(P)=a_u(P)$ for every $P$; this fixes its actual coefficients at regular places and at poles of $u$. Then there exists $r\in F$ such that $r
e0$ and $D(P)+C(P)=b_\varphi(P)+
u_P(r)$ for every place $P$. Thus the difference between this supplied $D$ plus this reduced cusp divisor and the actual polar divisor of $\varphi$ is the principal divisor of one nonzero rational function, with the positive sign shown in the equality. The same single $r$ works at all places, including all poles of $u$ and $\varphi$; no place is excluded and no uniqueness of $r$ is asserted.
